$comment: The country pairs used everywhere in the app (Send, Live Orders, Transaction History, Calculator, Run Demo, Random Test, cash-in/out). Every pair is a corridor in the fee spreadsheets (shared/fees/*.csv); sheetName is the country's name in those sheets. Edit this file to change the pairs app-wide.
